label: llm-stop-payment
alert: Container payment is exited (exit code 137); High p95 latency on product-catalog: 2185.3 ms (baseline 627.5 ms); Operation POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart on cart failing: error rate 18% [ongoing 5 min]
summary: The payment service container has exited (exit code 137), and the cart service is unable to connect to its valkey-cart storage, causing failures in the EmptyCart operation.
symptoms: cart service failing to empty cart due to redis connectivity issues
checkout service failing due to cart service errors

root_cause.description: The payment service container has exited (exit code 137), causing failures in the payment process. Additionally, the cart service is experiencing connectivity issues with its valkey-cart storage, leading to failures in the EmptyCart operation.

evidence.explanation: The payment container is in an exited state with exit code 137, which typically indicates an OOM kill or manual termination. Although the container health check says oom_killed is false, the exit code 137 is a strong indicator of a process being killed by the system (often due to resource constraints).
The cart service is failing to empty the cart because it cannot connect to its redis (valkey-cart) storage. This is confirmed by error logs and trace spans.

ruled_out: The product-catalog latency is a symptom of the overall system instability and not the root cause.
The astronomy-db and checkout containers are running, so they are not the primary cause of the failure.

proposed_action.expected_outcome: The payment service container should restart and begin processing requests, resolving the payment failures.
